## Dilemma v0.2.0-beta

### New

- Server-specific quiz points: easy 1, medium 2 and hard 3 points for correct answers.
- Current and best correct-answer streaks, answer accuracy and top-ten server leaderboards.
- `/score profile`, `/score leaderboard` and confirmed self-service `/score forget`.
- Finalized Discord vote processing with idempotent settlements, retry scheduling and restart recovery.
- Grouped help cards for `/help` and `/dilemma help` in six languages, without parameter examples cluttering the descriptions.
- Compact score profile and leaderboard cards without duplicated statistics or the scoring-rules paragraph.

### Fixes

- Generated correct-answer indexes must match available options.
- Poll closing is restricted to recorded Dilemma quizzes in the current server and channel.
- Profile card titles show the player's display name instead of a raw Discord mention.

### Privacy and safety

- Allowlisted error summaries avoid logging full Discord/AI errors, tokens and private topic names.
- Local pre-push checks and CI scan text/history and image publication candidates for secrets, metadata, QR codes and sensitive OCR text. Image review approvals are tied to file fingerprints.
- Direct deployment keeps credentials out of code archives, restricts the runtime container and retains one rollback version.
- PostgreSQL tests require an explicitly confirmed test host/database; the literal production endpoint is removed from current test code.
- Prisma is pinned with the patched deepmerge-ts dependency and regression coverage.

Scanners reduce accidental disclosure risk; they do not guarantee that every secret or image disclosure is detected.

### Beta note

Basic scoring features are ready for community use. `v1.0.0` will follow validation on live polls and feedback from real-world use.

### Verification

- Type-check, build, database/AI/feature/scoring/privacy/image regression tests and publication scans passed locally.
- Dependency audit reported zero vulnerabilities at release preparation.
- No schema migration is included in this release.
